pageHeader.title: Browse Public Servers
pageHeader.description: Search the public Project Zomboid server list and copy a server address to join quickly
pageHeader.reloadFromSteamTip: Refresh List re-shows results from the panel's own cache, which can be up to a minute old. Reload from Steam always asks Steam directly — use it if you just changed something on your own server and don't see it reflected yet.

apiKeyWarning.title: Steam API Key Missing
apiKeyWarning.description: Add your Steam API key in Settings before this page can load the public server list.
apiKeyWarning.step1: Go to <1>Steam API Key page<2> (opens in new tab)</2></1> and register for a key
apiKeyWarning.step2: Go to <1>Settings</1> and paste your API key in the "Steam Web API Key" field
apiKeyWarning.step3: Click "Save Settings" and refresh this page

searchFilters.title: Search & Filters
searchFilters.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, IP, map, or keywords...

serverList.title: Server List
serverList.description: Click on a server to see more details or copy the address

emptyState.noServersDesc: Try refreshing the list in a moment.
emptyState.noServersDescUnreachable: The panel couldn't reach the server list at all. Check the panel's own network connection, then try refreshing.
emptyState.noServersDescNoneResponded: A server list came back, but none of those servers answered in time. This is normal on a busy scan — try refreshing.
emptyState.noServersDescGenuinelyEmpty: The server list answered and it's genuinely empty right now. Try refreshing in a moment.
emptyState.noApiKeyDesc: Add your Steam API key in Settings to load the public Project Zomboid server list.
emptyState.noMatchDesc: Try adjusting your search filters or refresh the server list

serverItem.pingFailUnparseable: The server answered, but in a form the panel couldn't read — likely a version or protocol mismatch. It's running and reachable.
serverItem.pingFailUnreachable: The server never answered. Check it's running, the port is correct, and nothing (a firewall, a full disconnect) is blocking the connection.
serverItem.connectTooltip: Launch game and connect to server
